metadata.evidence_scope: Evaluates calibrated decision engine properties; does NOT represent unmonitored live production traffic or guaranteed zero false-hit rate across open-domain production workloads without runtime calibration.

measured_live_gateway_telemetry.latency_measurement_scope: Client-Side HTTP Loopback RPC (Python urllib socket roundtrip + JSON serde overhead). Gateway internal processing SLO (< 5.0ms P99) is measured in cargo test --test performance_test.

cost_model.cost_model_notes: Modeled assuming standard GPT-4o input/output token pricing ($0.00625 per origin call equivalent). Modeled savings are algorithmic estimates under this fixed pricing schedule, NOT independently audited commercial cloud provider invoices or customer telemetry. Keep simulated cost strictly separate from measured HTTP gateway latencies.
